note: One manifest: every check GitHub reports on a pull request maps to the local command that proves it. bin/pr-parity runs this set at pre-push and in CI, so a red check cannot be discovered after the push. A context with no command must be DERIVED (an aggregator of checks above it) and say why.

checks.reason: .githooks/pre-push already runs IDP_CI_FAST=1 IDP_CI_BASE=<merge-base> bin/idp-ci and exits non-zero before the wall is reached; CI's fast-gate job runs the same script against the PR base.
the gate/nightly variant of the same script on the same base; pre-push proves the fast half and the CI job proves the rest. Nothing here can go red without the hook having refused first.

the pre-push hook already runs ruff (E9,F,B,S + format) on every pushed Python in Layer 1c, using the estate's own pyproject rule set, and CI's ruff-required job runs bin/idp-ruff on the runner that has ruff installed. A wall that repeats it inside idp-ci refuses in images without ruff, which is a fact about the image, not the change (measured 2026-11-15: offline-gate).

bin/idp-pr-scope-audit grades a pull-request TITLE against the paths it touches; the title exists only after the PR opens, so there is nothing to grade at pre-push. It is deterministic given the title, and the agent chooses the title: type(scope) must match the changed paths or the body must enumerate them under co-changes. CI runs --live on the PR; a red scope is a wrong title, not an unproven diff.

the job applies a platform-feature request named by the pull-request template; it is a mutation of the PR branch, not a predicate on the diff. Pre-push proves the same predicate with `bin/idp-features plan --base {base} --head {head}` when the template names a feature.
aggregator: green iff every check above is green. bin/pr-parity exits nonzero on the first failing check, so this cannot be red while the wall passed.

the Greenlane engine posts this status after the lane lands; locally it is the sha256 proof that bin/pr-parity wrote (--proof), so a lane cannot be offered to the engine without the wall having passed.
